title: C-BRAIN Senior Applied Scientist (Remote) - Neurology
desc:
Location Remote, US

 Scheduled Hours 40 Position Summary The Consortium for Brain Research and AI in Neurodegeneration (C-BRAIN) is an academic-industry consortium directed by Dr. Randall J. Bateman, Washington University School of Medicine in St. Louis. C-BRAIN brings together academic research institutions, pharmaceutical and biotech companies, technology partners, philanthropic organizations, and government agencies to develop AI-powered tools to accelerate discovery in Alzheimer's disease and neurodegenerative disorders. Washington University serves as the coordinating center for C-BRAIN. C-BRAIN is currently deploying initial versions of the tools and developing plans for benchmarking and evaluation of the tools in addition to platform integration and scaling. C-BRAIN is also working on development of foundational AI models for brain aging and neurodegeneration. See www.c-brain.org. The C-BRAIN Senior Applied Scientist, Foundation Models, leads the design, training, and evaluation of C-BRAIN's biological foundation models for brain aging and neurodegeneration. Reporting to the C-BRAIN Chief Technology Officer (CTO), with scientific direction from C-BRAIN scientific leadership, this role turns large spatial biology, brain imaging, and longitudinal clinical trial datasets into models that researchers can use through C-BRAIN's AI tools. The work spans self-supervised model design for spatial multi-omic data, controlled scaling studies from hundreds of millions toward billions of parameters, privacy-preserving training in which each data contributor's data trains its own expert model, and the path from trained model to production. The first models to reach researchers are small expert models trained on each contributor's clinical trial, registry, and biomarker data; foundation models on spatial and imaging data follow. The ideal candidate has built and trained large self-supervised models on spatial biology and other scientific data, designs experiments that show whether scale actually helps, and works well with other scientists, data engineers, leadership, and software engineers. Job Description Primary Duties & Responsibilities: Foundation Model Research and Development Lead the design of foundation models for spatial multi-omic brain data: encoders that handle different measurement panels across datasets, spatial and cross-scale context from subcellular to regional levels, and fusion of transcriptomic, genomic, proteomic, and imaging longitudinal measurements. Define and implement self-supervised training objectives (for example, masked measurement prediction, spatial-neighbor prediction, and cross-scale prediction), and determine which data modalities add the most information. Extend models to brain imaging and longitudinal clinical and biomarker data, and design how independently trained expert models combine into an assembly of experts. Prepare training-ready datasets with C-BRAIN data engineers: quality control, batch-effect assessment, harmonization across sites and platforms, and train, validation, and held-out splits that prevent leakage. Track the research field and adapt published methods and open models where they fit. Scaling Studies and Training Infrastructure Design and run controlled scaling studies across data volume, compute, and model size; fit scaling curves; and recommend when larger models are justified. Train models from tens of millions toward billions of parameters on multi-node GPU clusters using distributed training (for example, PyTorch FSDP, DeepSpeed, or Megatron-Core) and schedulers such as Slurm. Build efficient data pipelines for very large imaging and spatial datasets, and measure GPU utilization, throughput, and cost so results reflect the model rather than infrastructure bottlenecks. Maintain reproducible training: versioned data and code, experiment tracking, checkpoints, and documented configurations. Evaluation and Biological Validation Build benchmarks and evaluation suites with domain scientists: embedding geometry analyses, recovery of known biological relationships, and downstream tasks such as cell-type identification, disease staging, and brain-age prediction. Compare models against published baselines and simpler methods, and report results with uncertainty and clear limitations. Probe learned representations for new biological structure and work with scientists to test the resulting hypotheses. Privacy-Preserving and Expert-Partitioned Training Train on contributed consortium data only through the privacy-preserving methods consortium data agreements require: per-contributor expert partitions, federated or confidential computation, and privacy protections applied to model parameters before they leave a protected environment. Evaluate privacy risk in trained models (for example, membership inference and data reconstruction) and apply mitigations such as differential privacy where needed. Work with C-BRAIN engineers and the partner-managed data and model-training platform on secure training environments, access approvals, and model release. Model-to-Production Integration Package trained models for serving: optimization (for example, distillation and quantization), model cards, versioning, and evaluation gates before release. Work with C-BRAIN software engineers to expose models as tools that AI agents and researchers can call, with provenance on every result. Contribute to production inference code, including Rust-based serving where it improves performance or safety. Technical Leadership and Scientific Communication Serve as technical lead for C-BRAIN modeling work: guide data scientists, data engineers, and research collaborators through design reviews, code review, and mentoring. Contribute to progress reports, Steering Committee materials, and grant reporting; publish and present results in line with consortium review procedures. Communicate model capabilities and limits clearly to scientists, partners, and non-technical leaders. Working Conditions: Remote within the United States, per current Washington University policies. Occasional on-site presence required for team meetings and consortium events. Occasional domestic travel may be required for consortium events, partner meetings, or scientific conferences. Standard office environment. Primarily sedentary with standard computer use. The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by people assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all job duties performed by the personnel so classified. Management reserves the right to revise or amend duties at any time. title: Senior Agentic AI Engineer

Develop Core AI Capabilities: Build robust retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines and tool-use capabilities to give agents access to internal data, diagnostic and resolution tools, and knowledge bases. desc:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We're looking for a Data Scientist - Product Analytics to join our Growth Data team. You'll own the analysis behind how people discover, adopt and stick with ElevenLabs' products, partnering closely with Product, Growth and the central Data team's certified metrics layer.

 - Define and own product health metrics: activation, feature adoption, retention and engagement across ElevenCreative, ElevenAgents and ElevenAPI.

 - Design, analyse and communicate the results of product experiments (A/B tests, feature launches, onboarding changes).

 - Partner with Analytics Engineering on the certified product KPI layer in dbt, and with Product on turning ambiguous questions into trusted analysis.

 - Work alongside fellow Growth data scientists on marketing- and revenue-adjacent questions that touch the product funnel.



Requirements

Demonstrated experience as a data scientist embedded with a product or growth team, ideally at a product-led company.

 - Strong SQL and Python, with hands-on experience in experimentation (A/B testing) and product analytics.

 - Ability to translate ambiguous product questions into clear, reusable analysis and defensible metrics.

 - Comfort working directly with Product and Growth stakeholders, and pushing back on ill-defined asks.

 - Structured thinker who can move fast without sacrificing rigour.



Bonus

 - Experience with activation / retention modelling or lifecycle analytics at a consumer or prosumer product.

 - Experience with dbt or a modern warehouse, partnering directly with analytics engineers.

 - Experience using AI tools or agents to speed up analysis or enable self-serve data access.



Growth potential

We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:

 - Grow into a Senior or Staff Product Data Scientist role as the Growth Data team scales.

 - Expand scope across additional product lines (ElevenAgents, ElevenAPI).

 - Path into a Growth Data Science lead or broader data leadership track.




LOCATION

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe, with the ability to operate in GMT and GMT+1 timezones. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London and Warsaw.

title: Cloud Billing Analyst - CCA

The analyst will consolidate, analyze, validate, and reconcile information from Cloud platforms and internal systems to ensure data accuracy, identify discrepancies, monitor key performance indicators, and strengthen billing operations. The role will contribute to the development and maintenance of reports, dashboards, standardized controls, and automation solutions that improve visibility into vendor consumption, billing activities, pending transactions, service levels, and overall operational performance. Working closely with Vendors and TD SYNNEX Country Sales teams, as well as Accounting, Finance, Commercial, and other internal stakeholders, the analyst will help maintain effective service levels and scalable service delivery aligned with TD SYNNEX's platform offerings and applicable Cloud Vendor requirements. “Let’s Achieve Great Outcomes. title: Data Scientist
desc: Our mission is to Profoundly change the standard of care by creating a tomorrow where clinicians can confidently ablate tissue with precision; a tomorrow where patients have access to safe and effective treatment options, so they can quickly return to their daily lives. Changing the standard of care is part of our fabric. We are a group of energetic, problem-solvers focused on innovation, and looking to change the world. We are changing the paradigm for treating diseases such as prostate cancer by using real-time MR Imaging, thermal ultrasound and close-loop temperature feedback control, to gently ablate the diseased tissue with minimal side effects. If you share our values and want to work in a collaborative results focused culture and want to make a Profound impact in healthcare and your career, here is your chance. General Accountability The Data Scientist researches, develops, improves, and evaluates the core technologies and features used in Profound Medical’s products through simulations and machine learning. The Data Scientist is primarily responsible for: Researching and executing simulations related to ultrasound propagation and heating in tissues, and magnetic resonance thermometry which are the technologies at the core of the Company’s product. Developing and improving Profound’s products using machine learning and deep learning methods, leveraging treatment and imaging data. The Data Scientist also stays abreast of the state of the art in these fields, researches what competitors are developing, and participates in the growth of the intellectual property portfolio. They work as a liaison with external research partners. Duties and Responsibilities Primary duties are as follows: Invent, develop, improve, analyze and validate treatment algorithms at the core of the company’s product, with the aim to maximize speed and efficiency while maintaining safety; Develop and execute ultrasound and MR simulations under various mechanical and physiological conditions to assist in the design of ultrasound transducers, or clinical workflows. Evaluate and research improvements to Profound Medical’s core technologies (real-time MR thermometry, high-intensity therapeutic ultrasound) and identify its strengths and weaknesses against its competitors’ technology; Develop, train, and evaluate computer vision models to improve treatment performance and safety using machine learning and artificial intelligence techniques. Develop and implement data analytics tools to assess treatment and test outcomes, predict technical failures, or track sites performance. Establish a liaison with external research partners, contribute to their research as needed, and transfer knowledge back to Profound Medical. Additional Duties may be required at times, such as: Contribute to real-time thermometry image processing algorithms Develop, test and optimize MRI protocols for various MRI models; and Contribute to system or software validation protocols and to their execution Investigate product complaints, perform root cause analysis of failures, and propose remediation in a timely fashion Generate Intellectual Property by analyzing, inventing and documenting designs and methods Interact with the wider scientific community through publications and attending conferences Participate in the generation of system requirements and specifications Participate in risk management and usability engineering activities Assist Company in planning, development, and execution of clinical trials. Assist in the regulatory submissions of products; participate in regulatory strategy discussions; liaise with physicians on future clinical investigations initiated by the company and external parties Education Masters or PhD in Biomedical Engineering, Medical Physics or equivalent Key Attributes Required: Excellent communication skills in English, verbal and written 3 years of experience with medical technology, preferably MR or ultrasound 3 years research experience (experimental design, writing articles, presenting at conferences) Experience with numerical simulations of physical processes such as wave propagation and thermal diffusion Ability to thoroughly document and summarize all aspects of development and testing efforts Matlab and/or Python A portfolio of scientific publications (journal articles and conferences) and demonstrated ability to relate to researchers Valid passport for travel to Canada, United States and Europe Desirable: Software development using C# or/and C++ Knowledge of high-intensity therapeutic ultrasound is an asset Experience of medical image processing and algorithms such as segmentation and registration Experience with building and training ML / AI models We thank you for your interest in Profound Medical. Please note only candidates that are short-listed will be contacted. The expected annual salary range for this role is $110,000 - $145,000 CAD. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and job-related factors. This role may also be eligible for participation in the company’s benefits programs, such as a group RRSP and medical benefits paid by the employer . We strive to promote diversity and equal opportunity in the workplace and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If selected to participate in the recruitment, selection, and/or assessment process, please inform Human Resources of the nature of any accommodation(s) that you may require.

title: Fraud Analyst
desc: Do you enjoy speaking with clients while using your detective skills to research complex situations? Join our team to ensure our clients receive the best fraud protection and remediation services in the industry. You will help to manage challenging situations by offering fraud detection, prevention, remediation and recovery solutions, and helping manage customer expectations. Demonstrating delivery of best practices, you will leverage your deep understanding of prevention capabilities and fraud acumen to make informed decisions that protect or clients. If you are a critical thinker and able to exercise and able to solve problems in a fast-paced environment, you may be perfect for our team. As a Fraud Analyst within JPMorganChase, you will work closely with internal teams and clients to provide a white glove experience during the remediation process. In this role, you will be securing accounts, handling claims, and completing all necessary steps to make the client whole. This role will provide you the ability to strengthen your current skillset and empower growth. Job responsibilities Identify and mitigate potential fraud risks using analytical skills to ensure robust protection for our clients. Collaborate seamlessly with various departments to enhance fraud detection and prevention strategies. Investigate detailed US & International Private Bank fraud activities, using problem-solving abilities to uncover insights. Manage detailed reviews with tight deadlines, prioritizing tasks and managing time effectively. Detect and address fraud indicators with keen attention to detail, ensuring swift remediation. Communicate clearly and concisely with clients and team members to facilitate understanding and action. Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills Proficient in delivering excellent written and oral communications at an executive level. Demonstrated ability to excel in dynamic, fast-paced environments by swiftly adapting to evolving demands and challenges. Skilled in handling highly confidential client details with professionalism, adhering to firm storage and retention requirements. Demonstrates strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and excellent follow-up habits. Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills Experienced in client service, with a focus on delivering exceptional support and solutions proven with at least one year of experience. Highly analytical, with expertise in collecting, analyzing, and synthesizing information at an expert level.   JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world’s most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management. We offer a competitive total rewards package including base salary determined based on the role, experience, skill set and location. Those in eligible roles may receive commission-based pay and/or discretionary incentive compensation, paid in the form of cash and/or forfeitable equity, awarded in recognition of individual achievements and contributions. We also offer a range of benefits and programs to meet employee needs, based on eligibility. These benefits include comprehensive health care coverage, on-site health and wellness centers, a retirement savings plan, backup childcare, tuition reimbursement, mental health support, financial coaching and more. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided during the hiring process. We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success.
